en.title: Through the Student Lens Festival Enhances Film Accessibility, Theatre Creates Inclusive Shows for Autism, Ireland Examines Basic Income for Artists with Disabilities
en.summary: This digest covers three key accessibility stories: The Through the Student Lens festival showcases various films while enhancing accessibility features for viewers with disabilities; a theatre company has created an accessible performance specifically designed for individuals with autism and intellectual disabilities, providing an inclusive cultural experience; and an examination of Ireland's Basic Income for the Arts scheme and its accessibility for artists with disabilities, exploring whether the program adequately supports artists with disabilities and addresses potential barriers to participation.

highlights.title: Through the Student Lens festival presents assorted work, boosts film accessibility
Theatre company creates accessible show for people with autism, intellectual disabilities
Basic Income for the Arts: how accessible is it for artists with disabilities? - The Irish Times

zh-TW.title: 「透過學生鏡頭」電影節提升電影無障礙、劇團為自閉症人士創作包容性演出、愛爾蘭檢視殘疾藝術家基本收入計劃
zh-TW.summary: 本摘要涵蓋三項重要的無障礙新聞：「透過學生鏡頭」電影節展示各種電影，同時為殘障觀眾增強無障礙功能；一個劇團專門為自閉症和智障人士創作了無障礙表演，提供包容性的文化體驗；以及探討愛爾蘭藝術基本收入計劃及其對殘疾藝術家的無障礙性，該計劃是否充分支持殘疾藝術家並解決潛在的參與障礙。

highlights.title: 「透過學生鏡頭」電影節呈現多樣作品並提升電影無障礙
劇團為自閉症和智障人士製作無障礙演出
藝術基本收入：對殘疾藝術家來說是否無障礙？- The Irish Times
